dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Distinct and sharp thin pale-tan boundaries along the outer edges of the folded primary and secondary flight feathers against darker grayish-brown centers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: A visible linear boundary where the relatively uniform light-brownish crown transitions into the high-contrast scaly pattern of the mantle.
